acceptanceCriteria.text: The release workflow no longer reimplements managed-generation identity in shell.
The descriptor consumes a canonical identity produced from the realized managed-generation contract.
The descriptor identity exactly matches `generationIdentityOf()` for the same manifest and realized Nix outputs.
Regression coverage proves a production-shaped descriptor survives exact generation-identity verification.
A deliberately inconsistent generation identity fails closed.

issue.title: fix: derive release managed-generation identity from the canonical runtime contract
